description: This file defines the Psr16CacheAdapter class which implements the CacheInterface to adapt a PSR-16 simple cache to the current project. It provides methods for get, set, and remove cache entries.

classes.name: Psr16CacheAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class implementing CacheInterface to wrap around a PSR-16 simple cache instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor accepting a PSR-16 cache implementation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a cache item by key with optional time-to-live.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a cache item by key.
